title: Book 7 — Polymnia, Chapter 179
paragraphs: Following the oracle, the Delphians still make propitiatory offerings to the Winds to this day. Meanwhile, the fleet of Xerxes set out from the city of Therma, and ten of its ships — the fastest sailors — crossed straight toward Skiathos, where three Greek ships, one from Troizen, one from Aegina, and one from Athens, were stationed as an advance watch. When their crews spotted the barbarian ships, they turned and fled:
